# Sparkline (`sparkline`)

Trend line with gaps and a last-value dot.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSparkline` (types in `dist/web/charts/sparkline.d.ts`): `.mh-sparkline`: a trend line from numbers, with gaps for `null`, an optional area and a last-value dot. Colour from `--mh-series-N` or the accent (`--series-N | --accent`). Parts `__svg`, `__area`, `__line`, `__dot`. `role="img"` with a summary of the values.

```ts
export function createSparkline(options: SparklineOptions): SparklineHandle;

export interface SparklineOptions {
  values: SparklineValues;
  /** What it shows ("Temperature, last 24 hours"); the summary of the values is added for screen readers. */
  label: string;
  color?: SparklineColor;
  /** Fill under the line. */
  area?: boolean;
  /** Fixed bottom and top of the scale; default: the data's own range. */
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** A dot on the last value (default true). */
  dot?: boolean;
  size?: SparklineSize;
  /** Formats values in the accessible summary. */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
}

export interface SparklineHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValues(values: SparklineValues): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSparkline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const readings = [19.2, 19.0, 18.8, 18.9, 19.4, 20.1, 20.8, 21.3, 21.6, 21.4, 21.9, 22.3];

const sparkline = createSparkline({
  values: readings,
  label: 'Living room temperature, last 12 hours',
  area: true,
  format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}°`,
});

// A new reading arrives: drop the oldest and redraw.
setInterval(() => {
  const last = readings[readings.length - 1] ?? 21;
  readings.push(Math.round((last + (Math.random() - 0.5)) * 10) / 10);
  readings.shift();
  sparkline.setValues(readings);
}, 2000);

document.body.append(sparkline.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SparklineExample() {
  const [readings, setReadings] = useState([19.2, 19.0, 18.8, 18.9, 19.4, 20.1, 20.8, 21.3, 21.9, 22.3]);
  useEffect(() => {
    // A new reading arrives: drop the oldest.
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setReadings((prev) => {
        const last = prev[prev.length - 1] ?? 21;
        return [...prev.slice(1), Math.round((last + (Math.random() - 0.5)) * 10) / 10];
      });
    }, 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <Sparkline
      values={readings}
      label="Living room temperature, last 10 hours"
      area
      format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}°`}
    />
  );
}
```
